bundle.longDescription: MotrWorks is a single-page electric-machine design tool: BLDC/PMSM, brushed PM DC, limited-angle torquers, hybrid steppers, spring-applied brakes, and squirrel-cage ACIM, plus actuator composition (motor + brake + gearhead) and winding tooling. Envelope-synthesis wizard, bench calibration, DXF lamination import/export, FEMM export. Runs fully offline; designs autosave locally and export as JSON files.
